name: Kobold Variants
body:
Behind the Screen
I’m basing these new Kobold species off of the most variant and bountiful source of all. Yes. I’m ripping off mother nature. I just hope that she doesn’t sue for IP rights.

The variant listed so far are bassed off of the Frilled Lizard, Monitor Lizard, Dart Frogs and Gila Monsters. Yes, yes, frogs aren’t lizards, but they are reptiles and it’s a cool idea.

In the land of Vadhu Orcus has culled the most dangerous of warrior creatures who fight, die, and fight again for him. Kobolds are not indigenous to Vadhu. They were brought through as part of the invading force. These are not the Kobolds that you are used to. These variants are vicious little bastards with a killer instinct.

Frilled
Greater
Poisonous
Tiger-Striped
